# dist

`m5-routeb-kit-2026-10-22-v5.zip` — Gate 4 kit for `toolchain-v4-ready`
(jobwrap root -> setuid 1003, netns, no_new_privs, fixed argv).

Defaults: `PYTHON=/opt/angr-venv/bin/python`, `GHIDRA_HOME=/opt/ghidra_12.1.4_PUBLIC`,
`CLANG=clang`, `LLD=ld.lld`. Per-job symlinks provide Patcherex2's literal
`clang-15`/`ld.lld-15` names; clang 18.1.3 is supported and recorded.

SHA-256 is in `m5-routeb-kit-2026-10-22-v5.zip.sha256`.
